decision: Does replacing the example-per-main anti-pattern with one library-level case runtime (tensorlbm.example_harness) keep the example physics inside the owner 15% band, and is the anti-pattern actually present and measurable in TensorLBM's examples/ tree?

alternatives.A0_status_quo: 161 stand-alone scripts under examples/, each with its own CLI, lattice build, time loop and post-processing (the anti-pattern as practised upstream)
alternatives.A1_consolidated_runtime: one declarative CaseSpec + run_case() in src/tensorlbm/example_harness.py, composed from library primitives (equilibrium / collide_bgk / stream); examples shrink to thin mains
alternatives.A2_independent_control: a self-contained example-per-main style script (xval/.../reference_main_channel.py) with its own BGK+Guo loop and torch.roll streaming -- not importing the runtime at all
alternatives.A3_analytic: closed-form references: Poiseuille u_max = g H^2/(8 nu) with H = ny-2 (half-way walls at y=1/2 and y=ny-3/2); Taylor-Green energy decay exp(-4 nu k^2 t) (Laplacian of the TG field is -2k^2 u), k = 2 pi/nx

hypothesis: H1: the consolidated runtime reproduces both closed-form references within the owner 15% band (<3% target) and is numerically identical to the independent A2 control (<1e-8 relative), while the anti-pattern is present in examples/ at scale (>=50% of files carry their own main, >=20% of lines sit in structurally duplicated blocks). H0 (falsifier): any physics KPI >=15% off its reference, or A1 vs A2 >=1e-8 relative, or the duplication index <20% (i.e. the anti-pattern is not actually there and this anchor is void).

metrics.M1_standalone_mains: count/share of example files with their own __main__, own argv parsing and own time loop (AST, src/tensorlbm/audit/example_antipattern.py)
metrics.M2_dup_loc_ratio: share of source lines that sit inside a top-level statement or function body whose name- and literal-insensitive AST hash occurs in >=2 files (distinct lines, not block instances)
metrics.M3_thin_mains: share of example files that import the shared runtime instead of driving the lattice themselves
metrics.u_max_rel_err: |u_max(got) - u_max(analytic)| / u_max(analytic) for the force-driven channel
metrics.profile_interior_rel_l2: same, rows 2..ny-3 (excludes the two first-order bounce-back rows)
metrics.tg_decay_rel_err: |lambda_fit - 4 nu k^2| / (4 nu k^2), lambda_fit = -d ln E/dt by least squares over the sampled history
metrics.record_digest: sha256 over the numeric payload of a run record (spec+analytic+kpis+history)
metrics.detector_gap: dup_loc_ratio(antipattern fixture) - dup_loc_ratio(consolidated fixture); thin-main share control
metrics.M2b_dup_driver_loc_ratio: same, restricted to duplicated blocks that contain a time loop or a streaming/collision kernel call -- the copy that actually drifts from the library

unit_of_analysis: one completed case run at a fixed (kind, ny, nx, tau, body_force/u0, steps); KPIs are scalars or per-run field norms

baseline_control.physics_baseline: A3 closed-form (no external table needed, no WITHHELD)
baseline_control.implementation_control: A2 independent main-style script, different streaming implementation (roll vs gather) and its own collision/source term; agreement proves consolidation is faithful, not a redefinition
baseline_control.detector_control: planted fixtures: fixtures/antipattern (3 near-identical mains) must score high, fixtures/consolidated (3 thin mains + shared module) must score low; a detector that cannot separate them is a null instrument
baseline_control.upstream_note: the upstream repository (sorush-khajepor/listLBM) is not vendored here -- its practice is characterised structurally (stand-alone mains), not by executing its binary; recorded as a comparison limit

predeclared_thresholds.resolve_rule: u_max_rel_err must not increase with resolution over ny = 16, 32, 48 (noise band 1e-3 absolute)
predeclared_thresholds.stability_rule: a run with a non-finite population or rho outside [0.95, 1.05] is declared failed and reported, never tuned away

stopping_rule: each arm runs a step count fixed before the run (channel: 8000/12000/20000 for ny=16/32/48; TG: 800 steps at 32x32) and may stop earlier only on the predeclared steady-state criterion max|u(n)-u(n-200)|/max|u(n)| < 1e-9. No arm is extended after looking at the KPIs. Local wall-clock budget 600 s total (no cluster needed); anything above that would move to the cluster queue.
variables_changed: detector input tree (repo examples/, planted fixtures)
variables_held_fixed: full Guo (2002) source term with u_eq = sum(f c)/rho + F/(2 rho)
half-way bounce-back on the two wall rows, periodic in x
analysis: for every arm report got vs reference and the relative error; a threshold is met only if the measured value satisfies it, otherwise the arm is reported FAIL; the resolution arm is reported as a table, not as a single best number; determinism is checked by re-running one spec and comparing record digests (exact) plus perturbing the spec (negative control, digest must change)
safety_limits: all runs are CPU float64 at <=48x8 / 64x64 lattices; no cluster job needed; artifacts are JSON + PNG under run_artifacts/

deviations.when: after the first dry run of the detector control
deviations.what: M2 was refined from counting block *instances* (which double counts nested statements and produced ratios >100%) to counting *distinct source lines*, and a second metric M2b (duplicated driver lines) was added because thin mains are legitimately structurally identical while carrying no driver logic
deviations.note: the predeclared thresholds (gap > 0.20, thin-main shares 0 vs 1, physics bands) were not relaxed; C9 now uses the driver-line gap, which is the sharper instrument
